questions.q: Which statement is an example of a business requirement rather than a functional requirement?
options: The system must support daily automatic bank statement import
Treasury needs same-day visibility into cash positions across all bank accounts
A scheduled process must import statements in a specific file format
The Cash Positioning work area must be configured for all US accounts
questions.explain: A business requirement states the outcome in business language; the other options describe what the system must do or what must be built — functional and technical requirements.

questions.q: Under TCM's "adopt, not adapt" principle, what should future-state process mapping start from?
options: An exact recreation of the legacy process
A blank page with no reference
Oracle Modern Best Practice reference flows
The competitor's ERP system design
questions.explain: Future-state mapping starts from Oracle's documented reference processes (Oracle Modern Best Practice) rather than recreating the current-state process exactly.

questions.q: What is a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) used for?
options: Linking each requirement to its design, configuration, and test script
Tracking bank account routing numbers
Scheduling the quarterly update cycle
Recording defect severity levels
questions.explain: An RTM links each requirement through to the design decision, configuration/extension, and test script that proves it, catching anything designed but never verified.

questions.q: What is a red flag when reviewing an RTM before testing begins?
options: A requirement has a unique ID
A requirement traces to a functional requirement
A requirement was gathered during a workshop
A requirement cannot be traced to any test script
questions.explain: If a requirement can't be traced to a test script by the time testing starts, it suggests something was designed but never verified.

questions.q: In the Brightfield example, what does requirement BR-CM-014 ultimately trace to?
options: A bank branch routing number
A UAT test script proving same-day cash visibility works
The Executive Sponsor's job title
A defect severity level
questions.explain: BR-CM-014 is translated into a functional requirement and eventually traced to a UAT test script that proves Treasury can see a same-day cash position.
